notes.title: Have You Played Tender Loving Care?
notes.content:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day of the year, perhaps for all time.

Oh good grief. Tender Loving Care was an FMV game from a couple of former Trilobyte developers, and last week was mysteriously released on Steam. And… wow. It’s… it’s weird. … [visit site to read more]
